criticalNote.text: The 1417 digital base transposes the words in the sentence identifying the determined genus with the human species. The 1404 print (p.79, canvas83) and the later edited digital text (I.134) both read فيكون هو الحيوان الناطق بعينه, “so that it is that very rational animal.” Arabic and English are corrected together. This is an attested transcription repair, not a manuscript claim.

noChangeJudgment: The full distinction of logical and real/derivational differentiae, ultimate differentia, regress objection, primary/common predication, substantial form and immaterial soul is represented without an omitted argument in the current English.

The existing English treatment of من غير أن تندرج تحته فيكون جزءا من ماهيتها correctly keeps the consequence inside the negative scope. The early print and later text both retain the same Arabic; do not add a negation or reverse the English.

The later editor’s threefold account of differentia (I.137 n.1) elaborates the author’s twofold division. It is commentary and is not substituted for the author’s two senses.
The early and later witnesses support correction of two mechanical spellings; several artificial paragraph breaks are joined without changing wording.
